title: TorchNPU renames PrivateUse1 to npu without initializing the runtime
summary: TorchNPU registration renames PrivateUse1 to npu, generates tensor methods, and excludes five quantized dtypes. The registry comment says this path must not initialize the NPU runtime.

hardware: Ascend NPU through the TorchNPU PrivateUse1 alias
conditions: Question is backend identity or generated methods, not a kernel implementation

claims.description: register_privateuse1_backend renames the backend to npu, registers torch.npu, and generates tensor, module and storage methods while listing quint8, quint4x2, quint2x4, qint32 and qint8 as unsupported.
The registry manager says registration must not initialize the NPU runtime and raises if torch.npu is missing afterwards.

downstream_impact: A missing torch.npu after import is a registration failure, not an allocator or graph bug.
PyTorch v2.15 custom_op device_types do not by themselves perform this rename.
recommendations: Do not treat version.txt torch lines as a tested build against PyTorch v2.15.0.
validation_plan: A later import check would confirm torch.npu exists and that the listed quantized dtypes lack generated methods, without claiming kernel parity.
limitations: CANN package check body and op_plugin kernels were not read. No device was initialized.
